modified_caption: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for different models across various categories. The horizontal axis represents the categories labeled as L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, T, R_1, R_2, R_3, R_4^+, while the vertical axis represents the 'Shapley value,' measured on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick intervals of 20 units. Bars are grouped by category, with each group containing three bars representing different models: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (green). The tallest bars appear in category T, where mBERT has an approximate value of 50, XLM-R about 70, and chLSTM reaching the maximum value of 80. In other categories such as L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, R_1, R_2, R_3, and R_4^+, the bars are all relatively short, generally below 15. Notably, the values for R_1 consistently exceed those for L_1 across all models, indicating a stronger contribution from the right context. A legend is provided in the top right corner.
